messages:
Maya: Morning — quick preflight for tonight's canary (9:00pm PST). I'm on-call but stepping away 9:20-9:40, can someone take the middle window if we need rollback?
Owen: I can own the deploy and the rollback window. I'll be at my desk from 8:45–10:15pm PST.
Priya: I'll watch SLOs and threading latency. Which cohorts are we doing again?
Kai: Plan was banded cohorts: 5% global seed, then +10% regional (NA/EU/APAC) with 15m waits. So sequence: seed -> NA -> EU -> APAC. Total target 40% then pause.
Maya: Correct. Seed = 5% all regions. If seed passes 0-error-span and latency < SLO, we go NA -> EU -> APAC. Abort condition: 5xx spike > 0.5% above baseline OR p95 increase > 200ms.
Owen: Got it. Smoke checklist I'm running post-traffic-shift:
```
# smoke steps
./tools/smoke_check.sh --cohort seed
curl -sS https://status.redwood.ai/health
# verify kv-cache hit rate > 70%
```
Priya: I'll set threshold alerts and pin the dashboard. Please tag me if you need immediate rollbacks: @Priya
Maya: Rollback plan: immediate traffic reroute to previous model variant + scale down new nodes. Who's owner for the reroute command?
Owen: I'll run the reroute. Command is `rdeploy rollback --to previous --reason "canary-fail"`. InfraBot, can you pre-stage the rollback runbook in the channel at 8:55?
InfraBot: Scheduled: will post runbook at 1700 seconds before deploy start and send an automated checklist message at 8:55pm PST.
Kai: Quick note on cohort weights — ensure the load balancer uses sticky-less routing for this run. If session affinity is on we get skewed signals.
Maya: Good call. I've disabled affinity for the canary window in the LB config: `lb-config/canary.yaml` updated.
Priya: One more: set the observability burn-in alert to 3x baseline for the first 10m then revert to normal. That reduces noise.
Owen: All set from my side. I'll ping here when seed is live and after each regional bump. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks. I'll be on slack until 9:20; @Owen take the handoff if anything after that. GL everyone.
InfraBot: Deploy scheduled: canary-start at 9:00pm PST. Reminder 5m before: will post.
